gates.zh: AuroraView 原生界面 / 停靠
共用能力 / Agent 契约

native.en: An AuroraView native entry and dock have no independent evidence recorded in this matrix.
native.zh: 本矩阵尚未记录 AuroraView 原生入口与停靠的独立证据。

contract.en: Host-specific page calls, events, and explicit Agent tools remain integration work.
contract.zh: 对应宿主的页面调用、事件与显式 Agent 工具仍需配套集成。

example.en: A host-specific AuroraView installation and runnable example remain ecosystem work.
example.zh: 对应宿主的 AuroraView 安装说明与可运行示例仍需配套。

scene.en: No AuroraView scene-state readback is recorded here.
scene.zh: 这里尚未记录 AuroraView 的场景状态回读。

cleanup.en: Owned and borrowed resource cleanup needs host-specific acceptance.
cleanup.zh: 自有与借用资源的清理需要逐宿主验收。

verification.en: Catalog presence is not AuroraView host acceptance.
verification.zh: 目录收录不代表 AuroraView 宿主验收通过。

native.en: Qt host adapter source is available. As of 2026-10-09, interactive UI, WebView, and native docking acceptance remain pending.
native.zh: 已有 Qt 宿主适配源码。截至 2026-10-09，交互界面、WebView 与原生停靠仍待验收。

contract.en: Maya 2026 mayapy passed HTTP/MCP discovery and business calls using the public shared Python preview wheel and DCC-MCP Core 0.20.41. Interactive page and event acceptance remain pending.
contract.zh: Maya 2026 mayapy 使用公开的共享 Python 预览 wheel 与 DCC-MCP Core 0.20.41，通过 HTTP/MCP 工具发现和业务调用；交互页面与事件仍待验收。

example.en: Merged Outliner revision bc934e7e consumes the public shared Python preview. Main CI and the mayapy contract fixture passed; interactive installation remains pending.
example.zh: 已合并的 Outliner 版本 bc934e7e 消费公开的共享 Python 预览包。main CI 与 mayapy 契约夹具通过；交互式安装仍待验收。

scene.en: The Maya 2026 HTTP/MCP run renamed an object, read scene state back, and verified Undo. The recorded run did not exercise an interactive WebView.
scene.zh: Maya 2026 的 HTTP/MCP 实测完成对象重命名、场景状态回读和 Undo 验证；该次运行未覆盖交互式 WebView。

cleanup.en: Unloading refused stale calls and released all 10 callbacks. Interactive WebView close/reopen and native dock lifecycle remain pending.
cleanup.zh: 卸载后陈旧调用被拒绝，全部 10 个回调被释放；交互式 WebView 关闭重开与原生停靠生命周期仍待验收。

verification.en: 2026-10-09: the public receipt records Maya 2026 HTTP/MCP discovery, rename/readback, Undo, stale-call rejection, and callback cleanup. GUI, WebView, and native docking are not yet accepted.
verification.zh: 2026-10-09：公开回执记录了 Maya 2026 的 HTTP/MCP 发现、重命名与回读、Undo、陈旧调用拒绝及回调清理。GUI、WebView 与原生停靠尚未验收。

native.en: On 2026-10-09, Windows Blender 5.1.1 / Python 3.13.9 passed 36 native HTML/GPU lifecycle checks. Full keyboard, Chinese IME, focus, and multiple-window acceptance remain pending.
native.zh: 2026-10-09，Windows Blender 5.1.1 / Python 3.13.9 通过 36 项原生 HTML/GPU 生命周期检查；完整键盘、中文输入法、焦点与多窗口仍待验收。

contract.en: The public shared Python preview passed 36 ToolSession → SDK → bpy checks on Blender 5.1.1. This establishes the recorded contract path, with full interactive acceptance still open.
contract.zh: 公开的共享 Python 预览包在 Blender 5.1.1 上通过 36 项 ToolSession → SDK → bpy 检查；该结果覆盖记录中的契约路径，完整交互验收仍待完成。

example.en: PR #5 is merged at 1401b6fe and main CI passed. The dated native-web guide documents installation and its limits; no public Blender release is recorded.
example.zh: PR #5 已合并至 1401b6fe，main CI 通过。注明版本的 native-web 指南提供安装步骤与限制；尚无公开的 Blender 发布包记录。

scene.en: The Blender 5.1.1 shared ToolSession → SDK → bpy fixture passed 36 checks covering its scene contract. Broader interactive scenarios need separate state readback.
scene.zh: Blender 5.1.1 的共享 ToolSession → SDK → bpy 夹具通过 36 项场景契约检查；更广的交互场景仍需单独回读验证。

cleanup.en: The native HTML/GPU lifecycle fixture passed 36 checks. Foreground normal Stop, multiple-window behavior, and user acceptance remain open.
cleanup.zh: 原生 HTML/GPU 生命周期夹具通过 36 项检查；前台正常 Stop、多窗口行为与用户验收仍待完成。

verification.en: 2026-10-09: both 36/36 fixtures passed on Windows Blender 5.1.1 / Python 3.13.9; the tested tree matches merged revision 1401b6fe. Keyboard, Chinese IME, focus, multiple windows, foreground normal Stop, and user acceptance remain pending.
verification.zh: 2026-10-09：Windows Blender 5.1.1 / Python 3.13.9 上，两组夹具均为 36/36 通过，测试源码树与已合并版本 1401b6fe 一致。键盘、中文输入法、焦点、多窗口、前台正常 Stop 与用户验收仍待完成。

native.en: As of 2026-10-09, native dock, pixels, input, and window lifecycle acceptance remain pending. Main revision 03815487 and the open PR #7 candidate are separate baselines.
native.zh: 截至 2026-10-09，原生停靠、像素显示、输入与窗口生命周期仍待验收。main 版本 03815487 与尚未合并的 PR #7 候选分别跟踪。

contract.en: PR #7 candidate 7f962b43 passed an actual UE 5.7.4 Editor SDK/Python/events probe. Shared ToolSet was false and reverse Agent calls were zero; that end-to-end path remains pending.
contract.zh: PR #7 候选 7f962b43 通过真实 UE 5.7.4 Editor 的 SDK/Python/事件探针。Shared ToolSet 为 false，Agent 反向调用为 0；该端到端路径仍待验收。

example.en: Plugin install and demo source are available at main revision 03815487. Native builds are recorded separately from the open PR #7 runtime probe and interactive acceptance.
example.zh: main 版本 03815487 提供插件安装与演示源码。原生构建、尚未合并的 PR #7 运行时探针与交互验收分别记录。

scene.en: The recorded Editor probe made no scene mutation. Shared-tool mutation, scene readback, and Undo remain pending.
scene.zh: 已记录的 Editor 探针未修改场景。经共享工具完成场景修改、状态回读与 Undo 仍待验收。

cleanup.en: The PR #7 candidate passed its Editor client cleanup probe. Native window lifecycle and repeatable close/reopen still need acceptance.
cleanup.zh: PR #7 候选通过 Editor 客户端清理探针；原生窗口生命周期与重复关闭重开仍待验收。

verification.en: 2026-10-09, candidate 7f962b43: actual Editor 5.7.4 SDK/Python/events/client cleanup passed, without UI or scene mutation. The refresh fix has mock-only validation; full native and shared Agent acceptance remain pending.
verification.zh: 2026-10-09，候选 7f962b43：真实 Editor 5.7.4 的 SDK/Python/事件/客户端清理通过，未覆盖界面或场景修改。刷新修复仅有 mock 验证；完整原生交互与共享 Agent 路径仍待验收。

native.en: Windows x64 EditorWindow / child-HWND WebView2 source is public. Native WebView smoke passed; non-batch Editor GUI, docking, input, and high-DPI acceptance remain pending.
native.zh: Windows x64 EditorWindow / 子 HWND WebView2 源码已公开。原生 WebView smoke 通过；非 batch Editor GUI、停靠、输入与高 DPI 仍待验收。

contract.en: Actual MCP stdio initialization, three explicitly registered tools, and current-user named-pipe calls into the Editor passed. The independent MCP adapter is a preview; DCC-MCP Core attachment remains pending.
contract.zh: 真实 MCP stdio 初始化、三个显式注册工具的发现及当前用户命名管道到 Editor 的调用通过。独立 MCP 适配器仍是预览；DCC-MCP Core 附着仍待实现与验收。

example.en: Public v0.1.0-preview.1 at source 12210315 provides the Windows Editor preview ZIP. Main/tag/release CI and public ZIP/SHA readback passed.
example.zh: 源码 12210315 对应的公开 v0.1.0-preview.1 提供 Windows Editor 预览 ZIP。main/tag/release CI 与公开 ZIP/SHA 回读通过。

scene.en: Seven Unity 2022.3 Editor tests passed. Actual MCP calls created and selected an object, read Editor state, and verified Undo. Browser-to-scene roundtrip acceptance remains pending.
scene.zh: Unity 2022.3 的 7 项 Editor 测试通过。真实 MCP 调用完成对象创建与选择、Editor 状态回读及 Undo 验证；浏览器到场景的回路仍待验收。

cleanup.en: Native STA shutdown, current-user pipe access, exclusive ownership, and endpoint close/reopen checks passed; the actual MCP run verified endpoint Stop. Interactive docking and lifecycle acceptance remain open.
cleanup.zh: 原生 STA 关闭、当前用户管道权限、独占所有权及端点关闭重开检查通过；真实 MCP 运行验证了端点 Stop。交互式停靠与生命周期验收仍待完成。

verification.en: 2026-10-09: source 12210315 and public v0.1.0-preview.1 passed release readback; Unity 2022.3.62f3c1 passed MCP discovery, scene calls/readback, Undo, and endpoint Stop. Non-batch GUI, browser roundtrip, docking, input, DPI, and DCC-MCP Core integration remain pending.
verification.zh: 2026-10-09：源码 12210315 与公开 v0.1.0-preview.1 通过发布回读；Unity 2022.3.62f3c1 通过 MCP 发现、场景调用与回读、Undo 及端点 Stop。非 batch GUI、浏览器往返、停靠、输入、DPI 与 DCC-MCP Core 集成仍待验收。

native.en: Houdini host adapter source is available; native UI and docking need version-specific acceptance.
native.zh: 已有 Houdini 宿主适配源码；原生界面与停靠需对应版本验收。

example.en: Use the adapter repository for installation and host prerequisites; a runnable-host result is not recorded here.
example.zh: 按适配器仓库查看安装和宿主前置要求；这里尚未记录可运行宿主结果。

verification.en: Adapter source is available; real-host interaction and cleanup are not assessed in this review.
verification.zh: 已有适配器源码；本轮尚未评估真实宿主交互与资源清理。

native.en: Nuke host adapter and dispatcher source are available; native UI acceptance is version-specific.
native.zh: 已有 Nuke 宿主适配与调度器源码；原生界面验收需对应具体版本。

example.en: Use the adapter repository for installation and dispatcher requirements; a current live-host example is not verified here.
example.zh: 按适配器仓库查看安装与调度要求；这里尚未验证当前真实宿主示例。

verification.en: Adapter source is available; scene readback and lifecycle acceptance are not assessed in this review.
verification.zh: 已有适配器源码；本轮尚未评估场景回读与生命周期验收。
